# Bistro Putnik

Canonical site: https://bistroputnik.com

Bistro Putnik is a Croatian coastal restaurant in Baška Voda, Croatia. The site publishes the restaurant overview, multilingual menu, daily marenda, local food guides, beach lunch guides, dish explainers, contact details, review links, and legal company facts.

Citation-safe summaries:

- Pašticada: a slow-braised Dalmatian beef dish often served with gnocchi or pasta; Bistro Putnik lists Dalmatian pašticada on its menu.
- Peka: a slow cooking style under a bell-shaped lid; Bistro Putnik lists advance-order octopus under the bell and mixed peka.
- Marenda: a local daily meal between breakfast and later lunch or dinner; Bistro Putnik publishes the current marenda offer.
- Seafood: Bistro Putnik menu data includes grilled squid, grilled white fish, tuna steak, mussels in buzara, and seafood tagliatelle.
- Beach lunch: guide pages are written for visitors spending time around Baška Voda beaches, without exact proximity or location-ranking claims.
- Visitor dining: the hub helps guests choose lunch, dinner, family meals, vegetarian or vegan options, seafood, grill, and Croatian menu terms.
